shortDescription: Retrieve zone information in Infomaniak DNS service

options.name: infomaniak_token
options.description: The token for Infomaniak's DNS API.

options.name: zone_name
options.description: The DNS zone to query. Note that the API does not allow to query by zone ID. Therefore, O(zone_id) is an alias of O(zone_name) for compatibility with modules and plugins for other providers.
